about:
B.S. Cable Company, Inc. was founded in 1989 in Lansdale, Pennsylvania. The business was recently acquired and refocused to address the evolving data center market.

The company operates a 40,000-square-foot facility equipped with state-of-the-art copper and fiber assembly testing equipment. It produces custom fiber optic and copper cable assemblies, maintains a large inventory of bulk fiber, connectors, and raw materials, and offers same-day shipping on stocked patch cords for orders placed by 2 PM Eastern. The facility is designated a Corning Gold House, and all U.S.-made materials undergo extensive testing before shipment. Imported cable options are also available at market pricing.

B.S. Cable primarily serves the data center sector, providing connectivity solutions for enterprise and telecommunications customers. Its quick-turnaround capability supports both prototype and production volumes, with a focus on meeting urgent demand for fiber and copper interconnects.

The company emphasizes its Corning Gold House status, same-day shipping on stocked items, and a deep inventory of raw materials as key differentiators. It also offers imported cable options at competitive pricing while maintaining a focus on customer service and rapid quote turnaround.
